local KillingCheats = PhantomForcesWindow:NewSection("Aimbot")

KillingCheats:CreateButton("Aimbot Gun", function()
game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.Character:WaitForChild("pistol good gun "):WaitForChild("Model"):WaitForChild("casing"):FireServer()
end)

if value then
  while true do
    wait()
  game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.Character:WaitForChild("pistol good gun "):WaitForChild("Model"):WaitForChild("casing"):FireServer()
  end
  else
  return
 end
end)
